verdict.rationale: Fly.io's marketing copy claims 'Roll back to any checkpoint in seconds' (fly-io-docs-9), which suggests rollback capability, but this appears tied to Sprites (AI-agent sandboxes) checkpointing rather than a documented one-click rollback for standard deployed services/releases. No CLI docs (e.g., 'fly releases rollback') or hands-on/community confirmation of this exact deploy-workflow capability are present. Missing for 10: explicit docs on rolling back a deployed app/service version via CLI or dashboard, a one-click UI flow, and independent verification that it works as described for standard services.
